info.name: MASVN Contact Popup Backend - All APIs
info.description:
Postman collection sinh t? ??ng t? Laravel router c?a `masvn-contactpopup-backend`.

C?ch d?ng:
1. Ch?y Laravel local: `php artisan serve`.
2. Import collection v?o Postman.
3. S?a bi?n `email`, `password`, `group_id`, `group_secret` theo database local.
4. G?i `POST /api/v1/login` ?? t? l?u `{{token}}`.
5. Ch?y c?c request JWT/connector t??ng ?ng.

L?u ?: body m?u d?ng ?? smoke test v? c?n ch?nh theo d? li?u th?t c?a t?ng API.
